description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 3040003440799 SHAFT,DRIVE,FLEXIBL: Line 0001 Qty 193 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0121 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
